title: Pay disjoint precursor labels and the original source clock
statement: For actual M5 boundary edges with two distinct disjoint filled precursor domains of area R2--5R2, simultaneous full-domain spin flip preserves thermal interiors and M5. The source theorem gives J2/C<=min(1,n*A_R^2*Dk/(1-u_r)), A_R=6n(ceil(9R)+3)exp[-(6theta-4log4)R]. The product is a positive label overcount, not independence. The actual kappa and rate-one site factor remain paid. The extension covers specified pure mergers below a4R2 largest-precursor cut, not nested domains, all hole closures or physical growth.
